procedure.method: In this fresh independent critic conversation, verified the supplied file byte counts and SHA-256 pins and read the pinned packet, case, rules, rubric, ratio policy, summarize.py, run_agent.py and all five native-evidence manifests. The packet declares no source assets or protected layouts, so those prerequisite lists are empty. Then used tools.view_image with detail="original", forwarding each returned image through functions.exec. Five consecutive member batches visually presented and were inspected in packet order: M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4 and M5 in the same view order. Each view call was awaited in its member loop. All 15 exact poster images were visually inspected before the first transcription judgment, any image score or diversity score. No image revisit was needed or performed. Actual PNG dimensions, RGB color type and absence of tRNS transparency were subsequently verified by reading PNG headers/chunks; no image was generated, resized or edited. No peer review, unpinned manifest target, maker inspection, credential, other round or additional plan was read. No agent was spawned, forked or resumed. Session/thread identity is not claimed; session_id is null.

content_form.location: upper-left quarter, hands and frayed striped cuff
content_form.observation: Two cropped hands hold the frayed garment at a visible needle/thread area; the repair subject is an action rather than an unrelated craft symbol.

content_form.location: lower-right half, worn book between two hands
content_form.observation: Hands approach the book from opposite edges, making a transfer legible alongside the repair. Wear on the cover connects both subjects to using things again.

hierarchy.location: middle-left orange title, upper-right black event/logistics, lower-left instructions
hierarchy.observation: The orange two-line title is the principal type focal point; event/date/time/place are grouped together above, and bring-items/activity/fee/invitation are grouped below without crossing the image actions.
The orange title and two hand/object clusters remain distinct. The event/logistics are smaller but remain a single identifiable block; the practical copy is less prominent than at usage size.

typography.location: orange title at middle-left and black logistics at upper-right
typography.observation: Clean Hangul strokes, a deliberate two-line title and clear date dots/time colons coexist with strong color contrast. Wide title tracking is controlled, though less optically compact than the body.

typography.location: upper-right logistics and lower-left four-line participation block
typography.observation: All required copy is readable at this size. The comma, middle dot and time dash are visible; the lower block has enough separation for each line to be read independently.

space.location: open tabletop between the upper-left repair and lower-right book
space.observation: The two cropped actions create a diagonal field of actual tabletop. Three text blocks occupy its different clear regions, preserving the active hands and balancing both occupied corners without a separate box.

space.location: title at left center and thread loop above it
space.observation: The title sits below the thread loop with a generous buffer; the blank region is part of the picture and connects the opposing actions. This is exceptionally specific spatial integration, rather than leftover background.

image_material.location: upper-left garment edge, thread, hands and button
image_material.observation: Frayed warp threads, the striped weave, skin creases and button are locally differentiated, under consistent soft light. The loose thread remains visibly separate from the cuff.

Cover scuffs, cloth-like surface, spine and uneven page edges have coherent detail; the hands hold recognizable edges. The monochrome photographic construction is strong, with dense thread tangles limiting absolute close-detail clarity.

emotion_control.location: whole photograph with orange title and invitation
emotion_control.observation: The close hands and used objects make the event personal and unhurried. The orange invitation adds warmth to the restrained grayscale rather than relying on an unrelated cheerful motif.

emotion_control.location: cropped participants at top-left and bottom-right
emotion_control.observation: People are represented through ordinary cooperative actions. The gentle lighting and worn materials communicate care, although the monochrome mood is quieter than M2 or M5.

ai_slop.observation: The major image elements have clear task roles. There are no unrelated decorative symbols, additional words, logos or watermarks; the book and garment do not acquire arbitrary inscriptions.

ai_slop.location: upper-left frayed seam and loose thread
ai_slop.observation: The fraying is densely tangled, but is confined to the damaged garment and the thread path. It does not contradict the visible repair action; local clarity is strong rather than exceptional.

residuals: Wide title tracking loses some word compactness at thumbnail size; the lower participation group is quieter than the main title/logistics.
The densely frayed sewing area is less locally clear than the worn book, though the action remains legible.
R8-C1-M1.assessment: A restrained documentary composition uses cropped hands, a frayed shirt and a worn book to make repair and exchange tangible. The open tabletop accommodates the copy with unusually good spatial integration.

evidence.observation: Bold illustration and cooperative gestures make the public-event purpose obvious and approachable. The open client style permits this vivid graphic treatment.

evidence.location: whole composition in relation to the other four packet members
evidence.observation: Vivid cobalt/navy vector handovers, broad diagonals and a huge white central event line form a graphic public notice. It shares hands/books with M1 but changes image expression, focal type, geometry and information placement.

content_form.location: upper diagonal, book held between two illustrated hands
content_form.observation: The book is visibly passed between opposing hands, giving exchange a direct nonglyph representation.

content_form.location: lower diagonal, patched folded sweater between two hands
content_form.observation: The stitched patch and folded garment add the clothing-repair subject. The two exchanges organize the main event band rather than functioning as small corner ornaments.

hierarchy.location: large white central event name and top-left logistics
hierarchy.observation: The event category remains the largest single message at thumbnail size. Date, time and venue remain a compact group in the upper white wedge, making the practical public-event function immediately recognizable.

hierarchy.location: lower-right bring-items/activity block and lower-left fee/invitation
hierarchy.observation: The two-line bring-items instruction is prominent; the activity line is clearly subordinate, while the fee and invitation receive a separate, readily found position. Several supporting blocks remain emphatically bold.

typography.location: central white event name on cobalt field
typography.observation: The very large Hangul stays within the edges and reads as one coherent line, with visible middle-dot punctuation. The blue/white contrast preserves it through reduction.

typography.location: upper-left title/logistics and lower-right instruction heading
typography.observation: All required words and punctuation are intact. Heavy type suits the public notice but offers limited weight contrast, and some pale edge offsets around the bold lettering keep the finish below exceptional refinement.

space.location: blue diagonal bands separating white wedges
space.observation: The book and sweater cross into the bands while text occupies the remaining wedges. The central headline has its own continuous blue field and does not collide with either object.

space.location: bottom-left fee/invitation and bottom-right instruction block
space.observation: Both blocks have usable outer margins. The right instruction block is relatively close to the sweater above and the lower-right edge, but remains contained and legible.

image_material.observation: White page edges, blue cover planes and navy contours make a convincing simplified book; the hands and cuffs share the same line and fill language.

image_material.location: lower sweater collar, patch, folded layers and hands
image_material.observation: White dashes differentiate stitching from the continuous dark contour. The folded layers remain readable, although the rounded stacked folds are schematic rather than exceptionally precise.

emotion_control.location: opposing hands and central blue event band
emotion_control.observation: The cooperative gestures communicate participation without an intimidating specialist scene. Vivid blue and large welcoming words give the event energy and accessibility.
The repair detail and explicit friendly invitation keep the assertive graphic style tied to a neighborhood activity. Its emotional range is energetic and practical, less intimate than M1 or M5.

ai_slop.observation: The two large object transfers have distinct content roles. There is no random icon filler, fabricated branding or extra copy; color and contours stay within a coherent small vocabulary.

ai_slop.location: book pages, sweater stitch paths and cuff marks
ai_slop.observation: Repeated page lines, cuff stripes and stitch marks attach to identifiable objects. The schematic details do not become floating decoration or contradictory objects.

residuals: Several supporting blocks use similarly heavy type, reducing subtle rank differentiation.
Pale offsets around some native bold type edges and schematic sweater folds limit exceptional finish.
R8-C1-M2.assessment: A vivid blue illustration places two object handovers across strong diagonals and makes the event name the central public-facing headline. Information is direct and emphatic, with some heavy supporting type.

evidence.observation: Separate photographic object cutouts surround a central blue instruction block; the main title anchors the bottom. Its inventory view, object-to-type proportions and information placement differ from M1’s action photograph and the other three systems.

evidence.location: whole composition in comparison with the other four members
evidence.observation: Three illustrated social/action panels alternate with cream text gutters. Brush display type, a zigzag sequence and explicit interpersonal narrative differ from every other member rather than changing only their palette or material.

residuals: M1–M4 share robust dark sans-serif supporting copy, and shirts/books recur as content. Nevertheless, their image expression, layout, focal type roles and information placement are substantively different; M5 adds an alternating social narrative. The set is strongly diverse, with some family resemblance rather than maximal independence.
set.assessment: Five distinct complete visual systems are present: documentary action photograph; emphatic blue diagonal illustration; repaired textile macro; everyday-object cutout catalogue; alternating illustrated social scenes. Differences include composition, type/image roles, information location, viewpoint, color relationships and emotional register, beyond material or filter changes.
